How Hariyata works.

A shared COD trust network for Sri Lankan online sellers.

  1. When an order comes in, check the customer's number.
  2. Use the verdict to decide: ship COD, call to confirm, or ask for an advance.
  3. After delivery, report the result: delivered, rejected or fake.
  4. Every seller's reports combine into a score that gets sharper over time.

Reading a verdict

More ink, more risk
Safe

Score 75 to 100. Has accepted COD parcels before. Ship as normal.

Confirm

Score 45 to 74, or little data. Call to confirm before shipping.

Risk

Below 45. Rejected or faked orders with several sellers. Take an advance.

New

No reports yet. A new customer. Confirm, then report the result.

Fair and private

Numbers are never stored. Each number is turned into a one-way SHA-256 hash before it reaches the database.

One report can't ruin anyone. A single report from one seller never produces a Risk verdict, and each seller holds one record per number.

Fake orders weigh double. A fake order counts twice as much as a rejection.
